question: A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between the Survey of India, Government of India and Assam State Government in June 2021 for the implementation of which scheme for rural property survey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Svamitva scheme.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Survey of India a**nd **Assam State Government **signed an **MoU** for the implementation of the** Svamitva scheme** in **June 2021.**
 
• Svamitva is **a Central Sector Scheme** launched by the** Ministry of Panchayati Raj** in **April 2020.**
 
• Its objective is to provide an **integrated property validation **solution for rural areas.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **property cards to rural landowners**, which will help them establish their ownership and access credit and other government services.
 
• The scheme also aims to** survey all rural households** and **map their properties** using **drone technology,** which will help in better planning and implementation of rural development programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Mission Suraksha** is a **COVID-19 vaccination drive **launched by the Indian government.

 
 
• A total of **Rs. 900 Crore** was allocated for the Mission's Phase-I over a 12-month period.
 
• The **Department of Biotechnology** (DBT) received the grant for the purpose of doing research and development (R&D) on Indian Covid-19 vaccines.
 
 
 
• **Mission Sagar** is a **humanitarian mission **launched by the **Indian Navy.**
 
 
• It aimed to provide **assistance** to friendly foreign countries during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Sahakar Mitra Scheme** is a scheme launched by the **National Cooperative Development Corporation.**
 
 
• It aimed to provide **technical assistance** to cooperatives in India.
